'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=乐月}} is a quest-exclusive NPC who makes her first appearance during the {{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}}.

==Profile==
Leyue is one of the members of the [[Celestials]]. She is based in [[Mengxuan Vale]], within the [[Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou]].
